hookPageSweep.pagesFrom: every /components/use* link on each site's /components page

responsesByClient.time: about 2026-11-20T14:52Z, at b07619f180 on both sites
responsesByClient.note: Every curl variant got the full server render: the Overview arrives at the end of the document in a hidden element, which an inline script moves into place. Chromium got the cached prerender, which holds the fallback and the page props but no Overview HTML.

curl.client: curl, browser-like headers (Chrome user agent, Accept, Accept-Language, Sec-Fetch-*, compressed)

timing.method: A mutation observer records when an h3 "Parameters" first exists, against the navigation start. Three loads per page, each in a new browser context.

cited.fact: hasTabs = hasPlayground || hasThemingTab || hasAccessibilityTab; hasAccessibilityTab is true when usage.accessibility or usage.accessibilityThemeCoverage is not empty; hasThemingTab is canary only
with tabs, ComponentDetailTabs renders inside <Suspense fallback={<ComponentDetailFallback/>}>; without tabs, OverviewContent renders directly
ComponentDetailTabs calls useSearchParams(); its comment says the boundary keeps the heading and every component with no tabs in the prerendered shell
OverviewContent renders the hook Parameters and Returns tables
everything up to the nearest Suspense boundary of searchParams becomes a PPR hole; the test keeps the component heading outside it
usage.accessibility has 2 entries; params: ref (RefObject<HTMLElement | null>); returns: animator (AnimatorHandle)
no accessibility entries and no playground
#9832 adds .filter(component => component.params == null) to the preview registry's lazy component map: a hook renders nothing to preview

history.subject: fix(docsite): stabilize PPR loading states (#5548)
history.fact: puts ComponentDetailTabs inside the Suspense boundary

history.fact: adds useAnimator.doc.mjs with its accessibility list
